title: Reconciliation evidence envelope
description: Evidence returned by a *.reconcile operation: the recomputed expected digest for a prior committed effect, so the connector can query/verify it. Performs no create or update.

checked_operation_id.description: Operation id of the prior commit being reconciled.

original_request_digest.description: Request digest (64 lowercase hex) of the original committed operation.

expected_digest.description: Recomputed expected committed-outcome digest (64 lowercase hex).
